vertices.purpose: What a drop carries: the dragged task id, the column it was dropped over and the index within it.
Props of a column: its id, its tasks and the drop callback.
Renders one column with draggable task cards; when a card drag ends it reports the drop with the task id, column and index.
vertices.sig_seen: function Column({ id, tasks, onDrop }: ColumnProps): any

vertices.purpose: Returns the drop handler that persists a reorder: it calls moveTask with the dropped task, column and index, then notifies the board to refresh.
Renders the board: reads the tasks, splits them into the backlog, doing and done columns, and wires the drag-reorder drop handler into each column.
vertices.sig_seen: function Board({ refresh }: { refresh: () => void }): any
